Idk what's wrong today. I'm in a shit mood. Have to deal with Ava stuff and Kate pointed out she lied about where she was staying. Kasia was in the group chat and didn't say anything. I feel like I'm being set up for failure. 
I washed the sheet last night but apparently it wasn't good enough for Kate. We tried flipping the mattress and she complained the whole time. 
I can't admit to her that she is the problem. I'm hiding in a cafe, in the garden, doing the food shopping. Anything to stay away. 
I hurt my neck yesterday at inflatable world. Now when I look up I feel like I'm being choked. 
My blood pressure is consistently in hypertension. 
I'm really hoping my week off next week is a reset..
